peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 20% above its local comparables; 123 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (60.2): 3.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 233 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,888,888 ($2,432 psf, 1,184–1,248 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,350 psf (range $1,757–2,460); 3.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $97,000 more. 4-bedroom: median $3,528,000 ($2,399 psf, 1,410–1,496 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,757 psf (range $1,701–1,902); 36.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $944,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 400 m, Sixth Avenue MRT about 1,060 m; closer than 441 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 470 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 240 m), more than 207 of 662 similar developments (the same as 35); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 1,380 m; nearest park Maple Lane Park about 700 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 660 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 670 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,300 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 1,440 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 60 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 297 new sales and 224 resales (521 purchases); new sales were 57% of these purchases. Subsales (7) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 550 m; Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 690 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 224 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 38 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 224 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 263 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.8%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
